S61.18.needs: a Cloud-unlocked account and a running task that has paused to ask a connector for input (hard to trigger on demand; the agent must ask a question through a connector)
S61.18.note: Only connector-input questions have an in-app answer form. Approval prompts are a separate flow ("Waiting for your approval"). The server push "Your agent has a question" (apps/web/lib/services/agent-notification-service.ts) is sent with the approval notification type, and the mobile notification tap opens the Companion screen rather than the task, so the push path to the question is inconsistent with the in-app path. The Tasks route is also named "AGI Work" in the drawer, and a tester may look for the word "Tasks" instead. The code for a question asked through a plain agent message, with no connector, was not found.
steps: Sign in and switch to AGI Cloud mode, then open the side menu.
Tap "AGI Work". The list shows Cloud task cards.
Find a task whose card says "Waiting for connector input" and tap it to open the task sheet.
In the sheet, find the form headed "<connector name> needs your input" (or "Needs your input" when the connector has no name). Fill in the fields.

Tap "Send answer" (or "Decline" or "Cancel" to refuse). Check that the note "Sent. The reply continues once every request in it is answered." appears and the task moves on, matching Expected: the agent asks, waits, and continues after the answer.
S61.18.where: Drawer (side menu) > AGI Work > open the task card that says "Waiting for connector input" > the sheet shows "<connector name> needs your input" with a "Send answer" button
